d: AKW Consultants is a specialist advisory firm providing consulting, assurance and technical advisory services in governance, risk, compliance, responsible sourcing, ESG, sustainability and integrated management systems.

Our clients include governments, multinational corporations, mining companies, precious metals refiners, manufacturers, financial institutions and international organisations across the Middle East, Africa, Europe and Asia.

As part of our continued growth, we are seeking a Compliance Consultant to support our UAE compliance advisory practice, with a primary focus on anti-money laundering and combating the financing of terrorism (AML/CFT), together with related proliferation financing and sanctions compliance requirements.

The successful candidate will work with AKW’s compliance team to help clients understand their regulatory obligations, develop practical compliance frameworks and strengthen day-to-day AML/CFT controls.

The role combines regulatory research, policy development, risk assessment, customer due diligence, compliance monitoring and client support. Assignments will include work with designated non-financial businesses and professions (DNFBPs), including dealers in precious metals and stones, and other clients within AKW’s practice.

Applications are welcome from fresh graduates and candidates with relevant academic knowledge, professional training or practical exposure to compliance. Responsibilities will be allocated according to knowledge, capability and development needs, with guidance and technical review from AKW’s senior professionals.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics or a related discipline, or an equivalent relevant professional qualification.
An understanding of basic AML/CFT concepts, which may have been gained through academic study, professional training, internships or employment.
A strong interest in UAE regulatory compliance and a willingness to develop technical knowledge and practical consulting skills.
Ability to work with sensitive information responsibly and follow established review, approval and escalation procedures.
CAMS, an ICA qualification, CFCS or other relevant compliance training, including qualifications currently in progress.
Familiarity with UAE AML/CFT requirements, DNFBP obligations or the compliance needs of dealers in precious metals and stones.
Academic projects, internships or practical exposure involving KYC, due diligence, screening, risk assessment, transaction monitoring or compliance administration.
Familiarity with goAML, screening platforms, compliance systems or tools used to organise and analyse customer and transaction data.
Arabic or other language skills relevant to client engagement and document review.
The role involves applying and developing knowledge of
UAE AML/CFT/CPF legislation, implementing regulations and applicable supervisory guidance.
The risk-based approach, enterprise-wide risk assessment and customer risk classification.
KYC, customer due diligence, enhanced due diligence, beneficial ownership and ongoing monitoring.
UAE targeted financial sanctions requirements, relevant UN and UAE lists, and the handling and escalation of screening matches.
Suspicious transaction and activity reporting, goAML processes, confidentiality and restrictions on tipping off.
Relevant FATF Recommendations, sector-specific risk indicators, compliance monitoring and record-keeping requirements.
We are looking for someone who demonstrates
Strong analytical skills, attention to detail and the ability to identify inconsistencies in documents and data.
Clear written and spoken English, with the ability to prepare structured reports and professional correspondence.
Professional integrity, discretion and sound judgement.
Good organisation and the ability to manage assigned tasks, deadlines and follow-up actions.
Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
A collaborative approach, receptiveness to feedback and a willingness to learn.
Confidence in communicating with clients and colleagues, and willingness to attend client meetings or site visits as required.
r: AML/CFT Compliance Advisory and Policy Development
Assist in developing, reviewing and updating AML/CFT/CPF policies, procedures, compliance manuals and supporting documentation.
Review clients’ business activities and help identify the regulatory requirements applicable to their sector and supervisory authority.
Translate applicable requirements into practical controls, checklists, workflows and record-keeping arrangements.
Monitor UAE regulatory developments, supervisory guidance and relevant FATF publications, and help assess their implications for clients.
Risk Assessment and Customer Due Diligence
Support enterprise-wide risk assessments covering customers, products, services, transactions, delivery channels and geographic exposure.
Prepare and review KYC and customer due diligence files, including identification documents, corporate records, ownership structures and beneficial ownership information.
Assess customer risk profiles and support the application of risk-based onboarding, review and approval procedures.

Assist with enhanced due diligence for higher-risk relationships, including politically exposed persons, and review source of funds, source of wealth and the purpose of the relationship, as appropriate.
Support ongoing due diligence, periodic reviews and updates following changes in customer information or risk indicators.
Conduct and review sanctions, politically exposed person and adverse-media screening of customers, beneficial owners and other relevant parties.
Analyse screening alerts, document potential and false-positive matches, and promptly escalate sanctions concerns in accordance with the client’s procedures.
Review transactions and supporting records to identify unusual activity, inconsistencies and potential money laundering, terrorist financing or proliferation financing indicators.
Document review findings and support the client’s designated compliance personnel in investigating alerts and implementing applicable targeted financial sanctions procedures.
Assist clients with goAML registration, account maintenance and reporting arrangements within the agreed scope and authorised access.
Support the preparation of suspicious transaction reports, suspicious activity reports and other applicable goAML reports for review and action by the client’s designated Compliance Officer or MLRO.
Assist in compiling information for regulatory submissions, questionnaires and requests from competent authorities, subject to appropriate review and approval.
Maintain clear reporting records and protect confidentiality, including compliance with restrictions on tipping off.
Conduct compliance gap assessments, file reviews and control checks under the guidance of the engagement team.
Help assess whether documented procedures are being applied consistently and identify areas requiring improvement.
Prepare findings, action trackers and management reports, and support clients in addressing identified deficiencies.
Assist clients in preparing for regulatory inspections and maintaining organised, accessible compliance records and supporting evidence.
Prepare training materials, presentations and practical guidance on AML/CFT, due diligence, sanctions and reporting obligations.
Support the delivery of training and awareness sessions for client employees and management.
Coordinate client information requests, meetings and follow-up actions, maintaining professional and timely communication.
Contribute to proposal preparation, technical research and improvements to AKW’s compliance tools and templates.
x: At AKW Consultants, you will gain practical exposure to AML/CFT compliance and work alongside specialists supporting clients with regulatory and operational challenges.

You will have the opportunity to develop your understanding of UAE requirements, contribute to client assignments and build skills in risk assessment, due diligence, policy development and compliance advisory.
We welcome candidates who are curious, diligent and committed to developing a career in financial crime compliance.

d: Location: Bahrain; Kuwait; Oman; Qatar; Saudi Arabia; Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates; Dubai, United Arab Emirates; Sharjah, United Arab Emirates

Timeless Group of Companies is a family-owned retail, distribution, trading, and investment group based in Dubai, founded in 2003. Its aim is to empower and elevate established and emerging brands in the retail world through distribution and strategic brand-building services. The group’s vision is to become a go-to partner for retail and distribution solutions, known for excellence, integrity, and fostering a community of thriving brands. Through subsidiaries including Times Square Group and J.S.K Trading Limited, Timeless holds exclusive distribution, procurement, and master-franchise rights for premium and luxury international fashion, sports, and lifestyle brands across the Middle East and adjacent regions. Its work spans retail, distribution, trading, investments, and real estate, connecting international brands with regional markets. The company’s values include People, Honesty, Creativity, Transparency, Operations, and Leadership. Timeless describes diversity as a strength, with a team of cultures and talents that supports creativity and innovation. Its workforce approach emphasizes inclusion, cultural diversity, mentorship, and equitable opportunity.

As a Senior Marketing Executive, you will lead integrated marketing campaigns and regional brand strategy for a retail and distribution group working with premium and luxury international fashion, sports, and lifestyle brands. You will plan sports partnership activations, manage digital marketing channels, and coordinate events and sponsorships that strengthen brand presence across regional markets. The role combines 360-degree marketing with content planning, audience and market insight, and campaign analytics. You will oversee content production schedules and collaborate with regional stakeholders to align marketing activity with brand objectives and local market needs. This full-time, on-site position is based in the United Arab Emirates, with work connected to the group’s Dubai operations. You will bring senior-level experience, a marketing education, and the ability to connect brand strategy with effective execution across digital, social, content, and live experiences.
q: Demonstrated capability in 360-degree marketing and integrated marketing campaigns, with the ability to connect strategy, channel plans, and execution into cohesive brand activity.
Sports marketing expertise, including planning partnership activations and coordinating sponsorship activity that supports brand objectives and audience engagement.
Brand strategy and regional marketing skills, including the ability to adapt brand direction to relevant markets while maintaining consistent positioning.
Digital marketing and social media marketing experience, with sound judgment in managing channels and aligning activity with broader campaign plans.
Content marketing skills, including overseeing production schedules and coordinating content requirements to support campaigns across channels.
Event marketing experience, with the ability to coordinate events and sponsorships and keep relevant participants aligned on delivery.
Market research and campaign analytics capability, including analyzing performance metrics and using findings to inform marketing decisions.
Stakeholder management skills, including collaboration with regional stakeholders and clear communication across campaign planning and execution.
Experience working with retail, retail apparel and fashion, sporting goods, or sports, leisure, and recreation organizations is advantageous.
Exposure to premium or luxury international fashion, sports, or lifestyle brands and regional market expansion would be useful.
Experience coordinating sports partnerships and sponsorship activations across regional markets is an advantage.
A Bachelor of Business Administration with a specialization or field of study in Marketing, supporting a strong foundation for brand and campaign work.
Seven to ten years of relevant experience in marketing, including senior-level ownership of integrated or 360-degree campaigns.
Fluent English communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with regional stakeholders.
A practical, organized approach to managing overlapping campaign, content, digital, event, and sponsorship priorities in an on-site, full-time role.
r: Lead integrated, 360-degree marketing campaigns across relevant channels, aligning campaign plans with brand objectives and regional market needs. Coordinate execution and maintain visibility of key deliverables.

Develop regional brand strategies for premium and luxury international fashion, sports, and lifestyle brands. Translate strategic direction into marketing plans suited to regional audiences and business priorities.
Plan sports partnership activations and coordinate sponsorship activity, ensuring the agreed marketing elements are organized and delivered in support of brand presence and engagement.
Manage digital marketing channels, including social media activity, and oversee content production schedules. Coordinate content requirements and timelines across the campaign calendar.
Coordinate marketing events and sponsorships, bringing together relevant internal and external stakeholders. Support consistent brand representation across activations and live experiences.
Analyze campaign performance metrics and market research to assess results and inform future marketing decisions. Share findings with stakeholders to guide improvements.
Collaborate with regional stakeholders to align campaign plans, channel activity, and brand priorities. Maintain clear communication throughout planning and execution.
